name: epistesys
description: Epistesys Beta-7.1 development support: requirement traceability, EpiMapLoss and EpiRecompScore, bounded validation, repair/resume, and explicit evidence and authority boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Trace requirements, validate changes and support repair.
interface.longDescription: A development tool connecting original requirements, typed context, finite-logic checks, EpiMapLoss/EpiRecompScore, binary state, resource ownership and Coding/Media boundaries. The declared Windows no-default-features test profile is recorded separately from other OS/features, external backends, general effectiveness and real-host delivery. Installing the plugin does not create execution authority or establish all-path correctness.
defaultPrompt: Use Epistesys Beta-7.1 to trace this development request and its validation gaps.
Explain the current EpiMapLoss and EpiRecompScore contracts without changing their formulas.
